objective: Add Neutral token and CSS utility classes for merged technical log events and implement EventLegend component with full test coverage.

acceptance.criterion: Neutral design tokens (--color-neutral, --color-neutral-muted, --color-neutral-border) and utility classes (.log-neutral-badge, .log-neutral-dot) are added to App.css and documented in CHUAN-GIAO-DIEN-FRONTEND.md.
EventLegend component renders all log legend entries defined in EVENT_LEGEND_ENTRIES, including the merged technical event using log-neutral-dot.
EventLegend unit tests verify that one entry is rendered per item and the 'Kỹ thuật đã gộp' entry utilizes the 'log-neutral-dot' swatch class.
CI frontend quality gates pass cleanly without errors or warnings (tsc, eslint --max-warnings=0, vitest, npm run build).
acceptance.verification: Execution of frontend linting, type-checking, testing, and production build
